parallax._note: Round 24 (Josh, MINEMAZE/7: 'This room would benefit the most from the 3d depth. The rocks could bulge a bit more throughout, using the texture shading as a guide for deep cracks and other depth indicators'): the parallax depth x3 here, its height 70% from the art's broad shading (bright rock bulges, dark sinks; a torch's painted glow is taken away first) with the cracks carved in -- the other rooms take the cracks and joints only

embers._note: the torches' flames are the shader flames; no ember particles (as CORICORI and SPAROOM)

gi._about: Bounced light (2026-10-09, Josh). Gentler room-level cut than CORICORI (ambient 0.6, not 0.4): the four torches reach only 31% of the mine directly, so at 0.4 the long stretches between them went much darker. strength/albedo as CORICORI.

visor._about: Room Review MINEMAZE/5 (Josh, 2026-10-09): a readout typed onto the visor as the player enters with the flashlight off; it clears when the flashlight comes on. lampOff = only then; delay = seconds after the room is recognised; hold = seconds it stays once typed.

volume._about: As CORICORI: black air that absorbs with distance, lit by the torches as they pass (shadowed); the flashlight thins it. paint = thicker black where the ORIGINAL art is painted dark.
